label: D1 after an unrewarded trial, late in the episode, leaning toward a1
explanation: Fires almost only at D1 (99.9% of mass) and only when the previous trial went unrewarded (in_rew = 0; never after reward). D1 & no-reward alone gets 99% recall but 8% precision, so other factors gate it. It is strongly tied to episode time: no activity before trial ~40, and the rate climbs steadily to trial 99 (67% of mass in trials 90-99). It is also gated by the agent leaning toward a1 (D1 policy logit choice > 0; 83% of mass when the upcoming action is a1) and by low value (67% of mass in the lowest value bin). Magnitude is largest with low value and late trials; top examples tend to come after strings of unrewarded trials. It never fires at D2 or after rewarded trials. The recorded predicate uses only observed variables: the reward input, trial time, and the agent own D1 policy logit. Dev scores: precision 0.45, recall 0.76, F1 0.57, mass recall 0.88. Adding value < 6.5 does not help F1. Read it as a late-episode, no-reward, lean-a1 low-value signal.
